name: Imohori ~Onii-chan no Funtouki!~
original_name: いもほり～お兄ちゃんの奮闘記！～
source:
Main character is half-engaged with another university student, but for formal engagement he needs her father's approval. Alas, father went on a business trip for a week. Protagonist wants to take advantage of his fiance at the winter vacations, so he is limited in time. He decides to live this week at their house. But he could not foresee all the seduction attempts from the members of the family...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与另一名大学生已经有了口头婚约，但要正式订婚，仍需获得她父亲的同意。遗憾的是，父亲外出出差一周。主人公想在寒假期间与未婚妻增进感情，时间十分有限，于是决定在她家住上一周。然而，他完全没有料到家中其他成员会接连向自己发起诱惑…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
